generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per NIT

technicalCriterionList.description: As per KW3 3.2 (b) The bidders shall upload the work done certificate for having executed any one building work of value not less than Rs. 21.19 lakhs and completed satisfactorily as a prime contractor within stipulated time period in the past 5 years (i.e., F/Y 2022-23 to 2026-27). Work done certificate shall be duly signed by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent

As per KW3 3.2 (c) The bidders shall upload the work done certificate for minimum quantities of work executed in any one year for following quantities (In a continuous period of 12 months from April to March) in the last 5 years F/Y 2022-23 to 2026-27) the certificate shall be issued by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent. 1)Earthwork Excavation-235.00 Cum, 2)Cement concrete (PCC&RCC)-92.00 Cum, 3)Size Stone Masonry-48.00 Cum, 4)Solid block Masonry/BBM-248.00 Smt, 5)TMT steel reinforcement-7.00 Tonne, 6)Plastering-775.00 Smt, 7)M S grill / MS Truss work-475.00 Kgs.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of minimum quantities executed

technicalCriterionList.description: As per KW-3.2(a) The bidders shall achieve turnover for an amount not less than Rs. 84.73 lakhs in any one financial year in the past 5 years (i.e. F/Y 2022-23 to 2026-27) (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) issued from a Registered Chartered Accountant (Registered Chartered Accountant PIN and UDIN number must be mentioned) should be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidders shall upload a valid registered KPWD Civil contractor Licence of Class III and above

As per KW3 3.2 (d) The bidder/tenderer or his identified Sub contractor should upload required valid electrical licence along with consent / undertaking letter for executing building electrification works and should have executed similar electrical works totalling for Rs.3.68 lakhs in any one year in the last 5 years, (i.e. F/Y 2022-23 to 2026-27) signed by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent for Electrical works
technicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Electrical License, Workdone and Consent letter if required

technicalCriterionList.description: As per KW3 3.3 (c) The banker certificate pertaining to Liquid Assets for availability of fund requirement for the work not less Rs.25.42 Lakhs issued by Nationalised / Scheduled Bank for the subject work addressed to Superintending Engineer (Ele), O & M Kolar Circle, BESCOM, Kolar
As per KW3 3.6 Bidders who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value.

Self-declaration letter shall be uploaded by the tenderer stating that He or She Shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Central / State Govt. or public sector undertaking of India.
The bidder shall furnish valid Schedule Caste Caste certificate issued from competent authority
